verdict_explanation: This raw verdict records the full theorem’s explicitly broader ambient and parameter domains. It does not identify an invalid theorem, missing source instance, or deficient source-obligation proof. Restricting to E=ℝᵈ and β≥0 gives the cited equivalence after derivative-notation elaboration. The candidate already states the differences, so no repair overlay is required.

source_review.evidence: Accepted scope: the selected C1 equivalence obligation, recovered by specializing E to Euclidean d-space and β to a nonnegative real. No admission of the subsequent Lipschitz-gradient consequence or claim of literal full-domain equality. Independently opened the pinned primary source. Definition 1.12 and Proposition 1.13 support exactly the selected equivalence obligation after Euclidean/nonnegative specialization. The candidate distinguishes its broader scope and excludes the subsequent Lipschitz claim. The displayed C¹ proof obtains the forward direction by adding h x y and h y x, using displacement negation and expanding the inner product. The converse establishes gradient(−f)=−gradient f, invokes the signed gradient-to-chord interface for −f with m=−β, and applies the first-order lower-model interface before negating. Each authored lesson formula has the matching sign and coefficient in these calls. The source omits Proposition 1.13 proof by analogy with Proposition 1.6; the latter uses endpoint addition and segment FTC. The authored explanation correctly labels the expansion as ASTIS-authored and refers to signed local interfaces, not an illicit literal application of Proposition 1.6 at its excluded negative modulus.
